empty_no_model_body: Go to the Models tab to select a band and character.
model_select_band_subtitle: Swipe to select a band; the character list updates automatically
settings_live2d_desc: These options take effect immediately and are saved automatically.
settings_fps_display_on: Shows the current render rate at the upper left of every model.
settings_fps_display_off: The current render rate is hidden.
settings_vsync_on: Match screen refresh rate to reduce tearing.
settings_vsync_off: When off, only the FPS limit applies.
settings_gaze_on: When clicking the Live2D or wallpaper, the model looks toward the touch point.
settings_gaze_off: When off, clicks only trigger motion feedback.
settings_bg_selected: Photo selected, applied to Live2D preview only.
settings_theme_desc: Control the app's color scheme and appearance. Changes apply immediately.
settings_dynamic_color_on: Extract colors from your system wallpaper.
settings_dynamic_color_off: Use the default pink theme when off.
settings_dark_mode_system_desc: Switch automatically based on system settings.
settings_floating_desc: Add multiple Live2D models as desktop floating windows. When locked, drag and pinch-to-zoom are disabled; when touch-through is on, clicks pass through to the app below.
settings_floating_permission_desc: Allow display over other apps is required to create floating windows.
settings_multi_part_replies_desc: Display one reply as several bubbles. Read aloud, regeneration and version switching apply to the whole reply. Affects future replies only.
settings_multi_part_interval_desc: Delay between parts of a new reply. History is displayed immediately.
settings_multi_part_interval_range: 0–10000 ms; 0 displays every part immediately. Default: 200 ms.
chat_reply_format_invalid: The model returned an invalid multi-part reply. Please retry.
settings_overlay_permission_granted: Allowed; tap to view the system setting
settings_overlay_permission_not_granted: Not allowed; tap to grant access in system settings
settings_overlay_permission_open_failed: Could not open the system overlay permission settings
settings_floating_no_items: Add at least one model first.
settings_floating_enable_desc: Shows the models listed below when enabled.
settings_floating_lock_on: Floating windows cannot be dragged or zoomed.
settings_floating_lock_off: Drag with one finger or pinch-to-zoom is allowed.
settings_floating_touch_on: Clicks pass through to underlying apps; the model itself does not respond to touch.
settings_floating_touch_off: Floating windows accept touch events normally.
settings_floating_no_model: First select a Live2D model in the Models tab.
settings_floating_reset_desc: Move all floating windows back to their default positions while keeping current sizes.
settings_floating_empty: No floating window models. Added windows remember their last position and size.
settings_wallpaper_desc: Desktop rendering uses the currently selected Live2D model. Only tap interactions are supported on the desktop; adjust the position here.
settings_wallpaper_enable_on: Live wallpaper rendering enabled. You still need to select BangDream Live2D wallpaper in the system picker.
settings_wallpaper_enable_off: When off, rendering will not start even if BangDream Live2D is set as the wallpaper.
settings_wallpaper_adjust_desc: After entering full-screen, drag with one finger and pinch-to-zoom. Save to apply to the desktop wallpaper.
settings_wallpaper_bg_default: Uses the current system wallpaper as background (auto-captured when enabled).
settings_wallpaper_bg_selected: Photo selected, applied to desktop wallpaper only.
settings_about_text: BangDream Live2D Android. Tap the Live2D display area to cycle through model motions. This project is released under the GPLv3 license.
wallpaper_no_model_desc: First select a Live2D model in the Models tab.
wallpaper_adjust_desc: Drag with one finger, pinch-to-zoom. Save to apply to the desktop wallpaper.
chat_not_configured: Configure the LLM under Settings → LLM Settings first.
chat_history_save_failed: Could not save chat history. Please try again.
chat_history_delete_failed: Could not delete chat history. Please try again.
settings_llm_desc: Configure an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible endpoint
settings_llm_custom_prompt_desc: Optional. Appended to the character prompt and sent with every conversation.
settings_llm_custom_prompt_hint: For example: Keep responses concise and use English.
settings_llm_http_warning: HTTP is allowed; keys and chats are not encrypted in transit over HTTP.
settings_llm_clear_all_confirm: Clear chat history for every character? This cannot be undone.
settings_allfiles_dialog_text:
Android 13 and above restrict normal apps from reading the system wallpaper.

Please grant all files access, then tap Use original wallpaper as background again to capture the current wallpaper.
settings_wallpaper_live_detected: The current system wallpaper is a live wallpaper ({0}). To restore a static wallpaper: System Settings → Wallpaper → set a static image; or use Wallpaper background → Choose photo.
settings_builtin_voice_summary: {0}'s {1} lines ({2} in total, pre-generated and bundled with the app)
settings_desktop_interaction_entry_desc: Touch/swipe/idle animations, action voice, bubble, etc.
settings_wallpaper_restore_failed: Original wallpaper backup not found; cannot auto-restore (rendering stops together with the wallpaper service)
settings_allfiles_goto_failed: Cannot open the permission page. Please go to: System Settings → Apps → Permissions → All files access
settings_voice_entry_desc: TTS, voice samples, built-in voice, etc.
settings_line_ui_desc: Use LINE-style bubbles and show character avatars in message lists
settings_line_nav_desc: Show the Line tab in the bottom navigation; stability is not guaranteed
settings_avatar_desc: Hidden by default; shown to the right of your Line messages once set
settings_experimental_line_body: Line multi-character spectator chat is experimental. It may be unstable or have performance issues. Enable the Line tab?
settings_headers_desc: Selecting the OpenCode Go preset adds an x-opencode-session row: leave the value empty and the app generates a stable session ID per conversation (constant within one conversation); fill in a fixed value to send it as-is; delete the row to stop sending it. Custom headers for other providers can be added/removed here. Authorization / Content-Type / Accept are set automatically.
settings_llm_context_window_desc: No send limit; only used for the context estimate bar in conversation details
settings_llm_image_input_desc: Supported by mimo-v2.5 / deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp; attach one or more images to the input box when enabled
settings_voice_mimo_model_hint: Default mimo-v2.5-tts-voiceclone; change it yourself in case of future changes
settings_wallpaper_mode_multi_desc: Multi: place several characters on the desktop at once
settings_wallpaper_mode_single_desc: Single: use the currently selected character
settings_wallpaper_manage_desc: Add/remove desktop characters; adjust position and size one by one
settings_original_wallpaper_desc: When desktop rendering is enabled, the current system wallpaper is captured as the background layer (the model sits between the wallpaper and desktop icons). Re-capture or restore the system wallpaper here.
settings_original_wallpaper_reused_backu: Reused the previous backup as the background (could not read the current wallpaper this time)
settings_original_wallpaper_captured: Captured the original wallpaper and set it as the background
settings_original_wallpaper_unreadable: The system prevents reading the wallpaper; use Wallpaper background → Choose photo instead
settings_wallpaper_read_permission_expla: On Android 12 and earlier, reading the current system wallpaper requires access to photos and files. You can choose a background photo instead.
settings_wallpaper_read_permission_denie: Photo and file access was not granted. The original wallpaper cannot be copied; choose a background photo in Wallpaper settings instead.
settings_allfiles_body_part3: then tap Use original wallpaper as background again to capture the current wallpaper.
settings_touch_animation_desc: Randomly play a checked action on tap/swipe petting
settings_swipe_animation_desc: Swiping on the model triggers a random action
settings_idle_animation_desc: Randomly play checked actions every interval while idle
settings_action_voice_desc: Whether to play the line audio when an action triggers (lines come from this toggle)
settings_lip_sync_desc: The character's mouth opens and closes with voice played on the desktop
settings_bubble_desc: Show text in a floating bubble when there is a line/reply (display-only toggle; does not produce content)
settings_interaction_hint: Tip: double-tap the model to chat via the input box; long-press anywhere on the desktop to stop the current chat/voice.
settings_reply_voice_desc: Synthesize and play with the current voice after the model reply finishes
settings_voice_sample_imported: Imported and set as the current voice
settings_voice_select_model_first: Select a character on the Models page first
settings_voice_samples_empty: No samples yet; import an audio file to use as the clone voice
settings_voice_samples_hint: mp3/wav only, ≤10MB; one character can store several samples, pick one as the current clone voice.
settings_builtin_voice_hint: Tip: after enabling Action voice under Desktop → Interaction & Animation, desktop actions play the lines above by action (idle speech is independent from the Random idle animation toggle); Text bubble only controls whether line text is shown, and Lip sync controls mouth movement while speaking.
settings_wallpaper_picker_not_found: System wallpaper picker not found. Go to: System Settings → Wallpaper → Live Wallpaper → choose BangDream Live2D
settings_line_appearance_desc: Customize chat bubbles and background; the current colors remain the defaults
settings_line_color_format: Color format: #RRGGBB. This color shows while an image loads.
settings_line_background_image_desc: The image appears behind messages. Remove it to use the selected color.
settings_line_image_error: Cannot use this image. Choose a valid image smaller than 20 MB.
settings_show_retry_desc: Regenerate remains available in the message menu
settings_show_context_usage_desc: Show the context progress bar and counts in chats
settings_llm_send_time_desc: Include your local date and time when sending; turn off for roleplay outside real time
settings_show_model_time_control_desc: Only hides the chat control; saved chat settings remain active
chat_edit_branch_hint: Sending creates a new branch here. You can return to the original chat.
chat_load_memory_desc: Load this chat as a long-term memory for {0}. Future chats will use it naturally.
